name: Dushevnaya

skills.name: Daybreak
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Hero's Code
skills.description:
Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 110% of attack to them. If this kills an enemy unit with Freeze debuffs, gains 1 stack of Ice's Grace

(TL Note: Ice's Grace stacks can be gained even if the enemy isn't killed with this skill)

skills.name: Marzanna's Sanction
skills.description:
Selects 1 tile within 6 tiles, dealing AoE Freeze damage equal to 50% of attack to all enemy targets within 2 tiles of the selected tile, and generates Frost tiles for 2 turns.

The next use of this skill will be enhanced, increasing the damage multiplier to 70%, whilst applying Frigid for 1 turn. This enhancement cannot be enhanced again if the skill has already been enhanced.

If Confectance Index is full, Marzanna's Sanction can immediately be used again.

skills.name: Book of Prophecy
skills.description: Applies 1 stack of Arctic Benediction to all allied units within 7 tiles. Gains 2 points of Confectance Index, as well as Glacial Domain for 2 turns. While Glacial Domain is active, gains 2 points of Confectance Index if it is at 0 at the end of the action.

skills.name: Blessed Artwork
skills.description:
Increases all allied units' damage by 10%, with an additional 10% boost specifically for Freeze damage. At the end of the action, gains 2 points of Confectance Index.

When the user's HP is above 80%, reduces Stability Damage taken by 1 point and gains Insight. While under the effects of Insight, increases the range of active skills and Support Attacks (except Ultimates) by 1 tile.

fortification.effect: Increases the effective range by 2 tiles and applies 1 random powerful buff and Movement Up II to all allied units within range for 2 turns. Arctic Benediction increases damage dealt by an additional 10%.

Attacks ignore 15% of the target's Cover damage reduction. At the start of the action, generates Frost tiles within a 1 tile radius around the user for 2 turns. If the user is standing on an allied Freeze tile, their Stability Damage is increased by 1 point.
Effective range is increased by 1 tile. The initial damage multiplier is increased to 70%. This will be further increased to 90% for the enhanced skill.

The number of Ice's Grace stacks gained increases by 1. When the number of stacks reaches 4, the skill's effect is enhanced, increasing the damage dealt to 140%. If the target is on an allied Freeze tile, the damage dealt increases to 160%.

Dispels 1 buff from 4 random enemy units within range. Increases the number of Arctic Benediction stacks applied by 1. While Glacial Domain is active, ignores 30% of the target's defense, The maximum number of Support Attacks increases by 1.

Increases the damage of active attacks by 20%, with an additional 40% boost for Freeze damage. After an active attack, dispels 1 defense buff from the target. If the user is standing on an allied Freeze tile, applies Vulnerable II to the target for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Lance of Longinus
keys.effect: Each Ice's Grace stack gained above the maximum amount increases the critical rate of Hero's Code by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Adventurer's Will
keys.effect: When an active attack only hits 1 target, increases Freeze damage dealt by 20% and Stability Damage dealt by 2 points.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Magical Support
keys.effect: When an active skill generates Freeze tiles, if there are Freeze tiles within range, triggers a tile reaction, removes the tiles beneath the enemy targets and dispels 1 buff from them. For each tile removed, gains 1 stack of Ice's Grace, up to 3 stacks.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Courageous Claymore
keys.effect: When using Marzanna's Sanction, if it causes the target to enter Stability Break, applies Defense Down II to them for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Heart of the Sage
keys.effect: When under the effects of Glacial Domain, gains immunity to movement debuffs.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Holy Light
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, if this unit is standing on an allied Freeze tile, 2 debuffs are cleansed.

keys.name: Common Key -  Artistic Inspiration
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / For targets with mobility less than or equal to the user or that cannot move, increases Phase damage dealt by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Wintersong of the Hero
keys.effect:
When allies deal Freeze damage, gains 1 stack of Ice's Grace, and increases Freeze damage dealt for all allies by 5%, up to 15%

Dushevnaya's single target attacks now deals Freeze damage, ignores 30% of the enemy's DEF, and increases Freeze damage dealt to enemies by 30%

At the start of the battle, increases damage by 10% and increases Freeze damage by 10% for the 2 highest ATK allies (excluding self)
